paragraphs: Ben Shelakot. R' Shimon said: Hanina ben Hakhinai found me in Sidon and said, ‘When you reach R' Akiva, tell him: did not ben Shelakot testify before all of you at Yavneh?’ R' Akiva said, ‘This ben Shelakot I do not recognize’: Niddah 52b.
